target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory
for f in finite_spectral_shadows finite_spectral_shadows_computational; do
  for pass in 1 2 3; do pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error $f.tex >/tmp/$f.log 2>&1; done
  echo "=== $f: exit=$? ==="
  grep -iE "^!|undefined control|Reference .* undefined|Citation .* undefined|There were undefined references" /tmp/$f.log | head
  grep -ciE "Overfull \\\\hbox \\([1-9][0-9]{2}" /tmp/$f.log | xargs echo "  big overfulls:"
  pdfinfo $f.pdf 2>/dev/null | grep Pages | sed 's/^/  /'
done
rm -f finite_spectral_shadows*.aux finite_spectral_shadows*.out finite_spectral_shadows*.toc finite_spectral_shadows*.log
